item.title: Oracle is building yesterday's data centers with tomorrow's debt
item.description:
📝 Key PointsOpenAI is walking away from expanding its flagship Stargate data center with Oracle because it wants next-generation Nvidia chips at new sites instead. Oracle is the only major player funding the AI buildout with debt, carrying over $100 billion on its books while free cash flow has gone negative. An Oracle spokesperson declined to comment.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/09/oracle-is-building-yesterdays-data-centers-with-tomorrows-debt.html
